SUPERSEDED_DO_NOT_CITE_AS_A_CURRENT_RESU.finding: S109 / V74 LANE 4 repository-wide stale-claim audit.
SUPERSEDED_DO_NOT_CITE_AS_A_CURRENT_RESU.what_this_file_actually_measured: the HISTORICAL sampling-with-replacement generator. Confound block labels were drawn as rng.integers(0, K, N_EDGES), so the requested K was only the SIZE OF A FACTOR POOL, never the number of occupied blocks. At K=200 over 200 edges the realised occupancy averages 126.6 (range 115 to 138 over 200 simulations), and the single build receipt kept as a positive control records 131 realised factors. This file's K=200 endpoint was therefore NEVER one factor per edge.

fields_in_this_file_that_must_not_be_cit.READING: asserts G2 contributes nothing against an edge-specific cross-modal artifact. WITHDRAWN.
fields_in_this_file_that_must_not_be_cit.g2_rate_monotone_in_K: true of these five numbers, but the numbers come from a factor-pool world, not an exact-K partition world. No convergence-onto-biology inference survives.
fields_in_this_file_that_must_not_be_cit.g2_rate_at_max_K_converges_on_biology_ra: the K=max cell was not the one-factor-per-edge world the convergence test assumed.
fields_in_this_file_that_must_not_be_cit.cells.*.edges_per_block: NOMINAL N_EDGES/K bookkeeping, not realised occupancy. The successor renames this field edges_per_block_nominal and reports realised occupancy beside it.
fields_in_this_file_that_must_not_be_cit.degenerate_end_note: the structural-identity statement is an ARGUMENT and may be true of an exact-K world, but it is FALSE as applied to this file's K=200 world, which carried about 127 factors across 200 edges.
fields_in_this_file_that_must_not_be_cit.what_this_cannot_establish: its closing sentence makes the same misapplication and is withdrawn for the same reason.
fields_in_this_file_that_must_not_be_cit.status: 'COMPLETE' describes the run, not the standing of its conclusion.

superseded_by.what_it_did: exact K-occupied balanced partition, realised occupancy equal to requested K at every point, 100 draws at 282 donors.
superseded_by.its_result: G2 pass rate 0.20, 0.25, 0.40, 0.65, 0.50 at K = 1, 5, 20, 50, 200. NON-MONOTONE. By the pre-committed reading NO protection claim may be made in either direction.
superseded_by.geometry_evidence: results/v64/phase_b_design/V64_CONFOUND_BLOCK_GEOMETRY_VERIFICATION_V1.json recovers the partition from the written ATAC bytes and carries the historical generator as its positive control.

the_distinction_that_must_be_preserved.A_EMPIRICAL: whether G2 protects against edge-specific cross-modal confounding. Status: UNRESOLVED. Neither this file nor the repaired curve settles it.
the_distinction_that_must_be_preserved.B_STRUCTURAL: that a completely edge-private latent factor loading on both RNA and ATAC can be observationally indistinguishable from a regulatory latent under this observation model. This is a CONCEPTUAL ARGUMENT. It never depended on either curve, it is not an empirical result, and it must not be inflated into a stronger biological claim than it supports.

SUPERSEDED_DO_NOT_CITE_AS_A_CURRENT_RESU.nothing_was_deleted: every field emitted by the historical runner is retained verbatim beneath this header. Deleting a measurement because its interpretation did not survive is worse than carrying it with its qualification attached.

convergence_test.definition: the K=max cell's Wilson 95 percent interval overlaps the biology reference's Wilson 95 percent interval
convergence_test.frozen_in: AMENDMENT_1 of the pre-commitment, before any draw
convergence_test.THIS_TEST_IS_WEAK_AND_IS_NOT_THE_PRIMARY: with 20 draws per cell against a 25-of-40 reference, the overlap test fails only if the K=max rate lands at or below about 3 of 20 or at 20 of 20. It therefore declares convergence across most of the range and must be read as corroboration, never as confirmation. The PRIMARY evidence is the SHAPE of the curve across all five K values: a monotone rise from near the V2 hidden-confound rate to near the biology rate is unmistakable in a way a single endpoint comparison is not, and the reading below requires monotonicity AND overlap together.

reference_values_from_the_V2_sweep.note: measured in V64_STAGE4_CALIBRATION_SWEEP_V2, not re-derived here

primary_evidence: the shape of the G2 pass rate across the five K values
corroborating_evidence: the endpoint overlap test, which is weak by construction
READING: G2 responds to SHARED structure across edges, not to cross-modal confounding as such. At K equal to the edge count it passes the confounded world at the rate it passes genuine biology, so it contributes nothing against an edge-specific cross-modal artifact. The V2 hidden-confound rejection rate must not be cited as a safeguard.
degenerate_end_note: at K equal to the edge count the confounded world is the same statistical object as the planted biology, so a low rejection rate there is a tautology and not a defect
what_this_cannot_establish: The confound's magnitude, its orthogonality to depth and its metacell-level structure are all choices I made. This measures how the frozen decision rule responds to a family of synthetic confounds parameterised by sharing. It says nothing about whether a confound of this kind exists in the real substrate, nor about its likely K if it does. It also cannot rescue the degenerate end of the curve: at K equal to the edge count the world is structurally identical to planted biology, so a low rejection rate there is not a failure of the design but a statement that the two are the same object.
